name: Garden spade
definition: long-handled tool with a flat, sharp-edged blade pushed in by foot to dig and cut soil.

name: Garden fork
definition: long-handled tool with stout tines to dig, loosen and turn soil.

name: Shovel
definition: long-handled tool with a broad, dished blade to lift and move loose soil or material.

name: Mattock
definition: swung tool with a heavy head carrying an adze blade, used to break hard ground and cut roots.

name: Hand trowel
definition: short-handled scoop-shaped blade for digging small planting holes.

name: Bulb planter
definition: tool that cuts and lifts a plug of soil to make a hole for a bulb.

name: Hoe
definition: long-handled tool with a blade drawn or pushed through the soil surface to weed and loosen it.

name: Hand cultivator
definition: tined tool, hand-held or on a handle, that breaks up and aerates the soil surface.

name: Garden rake (soil rake)
definition: rake with short rigid teeth on a straight head to level and break soil.

name: Garden sieve
definition: framed mesh riddle that sifts soil or compost.

name: Secateurs
definition: one-handed scissor-action pruning shears for stems and small branches, manual or powered; bypass, anvil and ratchet are the attribute `cutting_action`.

name: Loppers
definition: long-handled two-handed pruning shears for thicker branches.

name: Pruning saw
definition: hand saw with a toothed blade made to cut living branches.

name: Pole pruner (high-branch shears)
definition: pruning head on a long pole, worked from the ground to cut high branches.

name: Chainsaw
definition: hand-held saw with a powered toothed chain running round a guide bar, for felling, pruning and cutting wood (`drive` petrol, cordless or corded; K-173).

name: Pole saw
definition: powered saw head on a long pole for cutting high branches from the ground (K-173).

name: Hedge shears
definition: two-handed long-bladed shears for clipping hedges and shrubs.

name: Hedge trimmer
definition: powered tool with a reciprocating toothed blade bar for cutting hedges.

name: Sickle
definition: one-handed curved blade for cutting grass and crops.

name: Scythe
definition: long-shafted two-handed tool with a long curved blade swung to mow grass.

name: Brush cutter
definition: powered shaft machine with a metal blade or line head for clearing brush, scrub and long grass.

name: Billhook
definition: hooked chopping blade on a short handle for cutting brush, hedge laying and coppice work.

name: Machete
definition: long heavy-bladed knife swung to cut vegetation.

name: Garden multi-tool (split-shaft powerhead)
definition: powered handle and motor unit that takes interchangeable cutting attachments (grass trimmer, hedge trimmer, pole pruner, brush cutter); provisional until a harvested seller page shows the class (memo section 14, C-10).

name: Cylinder mower
definition: mower that cuts with a rotating reel of blades against a fixed bottom blade.

name: Rotary mower
definition: wheeled mower that cuts with a blade spinning horizontally under a deck.

name: Hover mower
definition: rotary mower that floats on a cushion of air instead of wheels.

name: Robotic mower
definition: self-guided battery mower that mows a set area on its own (a kind under C10(b)).

name: Ride-on mower
definition: mower that carries its seated operator while it cuts.

name: Lawn tractor
definition: lawn or garden tractor with a mowing deck, without a rear power take-off and a Category 1 or larger three-point hitch (with both it is C7; K-99).

name: Lawn trimmer / string trimmer
definition: powered tool that cuts grass at lawn edges and around obstacles with a spinning line or light blade.

name: Scarifier
definition: machine or tool that rakes thatch and moss out of a lawn with blades or tines.

name: Broadcast spreader
definition: wheeled or hand-held hopper that spreads seed or granular feed over a lawn.

name: Lawn roller
definition: weighted drum pushed or pulled to firm and level a lawn.

name: Lawn aerator
definition: tool or machine that spikes or cores a lawn to let air and water into the soil.

name: Artificial turf
definition: synthetic grass surface sold in rolls or tiles to lay as a lawn.

name: Garden stone
definition: stone, gravel included, and bark sold as decorative ground cover (K-174, K-187).

name: Leaf rake
definition: wide fan-shaped rake with springy tines for gathering leaves and debris.

name: Leaf blower
definition: powered machine that blows leaves and debris into heaps; a blower-vac that also sucks and shreds is this kind with the vacuum function an attribute.

name: Garden shredder
definition: machine that shreds garden prunings and green waste into small pieces.

name: Wood chipper
definition: chipper for branches and brush that is not tractor-driven, towed or self-propelled, for tree surgery and grounds (C7-O1).

name: Pressure washer
definition: powered pump that sprays water at high pressure to clean paths, drives, patios and vehicles.

name: Wheelbarrow
definition: wheeled container with handles for carrying soil, waste and materials in a garden; a garden cart is this kind.

name: Snow shovel / pusher
definition: wide-bladed hand shovel or pusher for clearing snow.

name: Snow blower
definition: powered machine that gathers snow and throws it clear of a path or drive.

name: Garden hose
definition: flexible hose for carrying water in a garden.

name: Hose reel
definition: reel or cart on which a garden hose is wound and stored.

name: Lawn sprinkler
definition: device that sprays water over an area of lawn or bed; pop-up, oscillating and rotary heads are attributes.

name: Drip irrigation kit
definition: set of pipe, drippers and fittings that delivers water drop by drop to plants (balcony and terrace set sizes are variants).

name: Soaker hose
definition: porous hose that seeps water along its length into the soil.

name: Irrigation controller
definition: timer or controller that switches the water supply to a garden irrigation system.

name: Watering can
definition: hand-carried vessel with a spout, often with a rose, for watering plants.

name: Garden water pump
definition: pump made to move water for watering and irrigation in a garden (K-175).

name: Pond and fountain pump
definition: pump made to circulate water in a garden pond, fountain or water feature (K-175, K-104, B4-O1).

name: Water butt / rain tank
definition: container that collects and stores rainwater for garden use (K-177).

name: Pond liner
definition: flexible waterproof sheet laid to form a garden pond (K-104).

name: Preformed pond
definition: rigid moulded pond shell set into the ground (K-104).

name: Plant pot
definition: container with drainage in which a plant grows.

name: Window box
definition: long narrow planter made to sit on or hang from a window sill or railing.

name: Hanging basket
definition: basket or container hung from a bracket or chain to grow plants in.

name: Bonsai pot
definition: shallow glazed or unglazed pot with drainage and wire holes, made for growing bonsai.

name: Fabric grow pot / grow bag
definition: pot made of breathable fabric that air-prunes roots.

name: Plant saucer
definition: shallow dish set under a pot to catch drained water.

name: Cachepot (overpot)
definition: decorative outer container without drainage that holds a potted plant (K-179).

name: Self-watering planter
definition: planter with a built-in reservoir that feeds water to the roots.

name: Raised bed
definition: framed bed standing above ground level, filled with soil to grow plants in.

name: Plant stake (cane)
definition: rod or cane pushed into the soil to hold up a plant.

name: Plant tie
definition: tie, twine or clip that fastens a plant to its support.

name: Plant label
definition: tag or marker that names a plant in a pot or bed.

name: Plant netting
definition: netting made to support climbing plants or protect crops from birds and pests (K-187).

name: Horticultural fleece
definition: light non-woven fabric laid over plants to protect them from frost and pests.

name: Cloche
definition: small transparent cover placed over plants to shelter and warm them.

name: Trellis
definition: open lattice panel on which climbing plants are trained (B4-O1).

name: Garden arch
definition: arched frame over a path on which climbing plants are grown (B4-O1).

name: Obelisk
definition: free-standing tapering frame on which climbing plants are grown (B4-O1).

name: Potting compost
definition: prepared growing medium for pots and containers.

name: Mulch
definition: material spread on the soil surface to hold moisture and suppress weeds, bark mulch included (K-174).

name: Topsoil
definition: screened upper soil sold for beds, lawns and filling.

name: Soil improver
definition: material dug into soil to improve its structure or fertility (K-174).

name: Fertiliser
definition: product that supplies plant nutrients, granular, liquid or slow-release.

name: Herbicide
definition: weed killer made to kill or control unwanted plants (K-178).

name: Insecticide (pest killer)
definition: product that kills or repels insects and other pests on plants (K-178).

name: Fungicide
definition: product that prevents or treats fungal disease on plants.

name: Garden sprayer (pump sprayer)
definition: hand-pumped or powered sprayer for applying liquid feeds and plant-protection products.

name: Soil test kit
definition: kit for testing garden soil for pH or nutrients.

name: Compost bin
definition: container in which garden and kitchen waste is composted.

name: Greenhouse
definition: glazed framed structure in which plants are grown under shelter.

name: Polytunnel
definition: hoop-framed tunnel covered in polythene film for growing plants under cover.

name: Cold frame
definition: low glazed box that shelters plants and seedlings outdoors.

name: Grow light
definition: lamp made to give light for plant growth; LED, HPS, CMH and fluorescent are the attribute lamp technology (C-14).

name: Grow tent
definition: lightproof reflective fabric tent on a frame for growing plants indoors under lights.

name: Propagator
definition: covered tray, heated or not, for raising seeds and cuttings.

name: Hydroponic system
definition: system that grows plants without soil, roots fed by a nutrient solution.

name: Above-ground pool
definition: framed swimming pool that stands on the ground.

name: Soft-sided pool
definition: swimming pool with flexible walls, held by an inflatable ring or by the water (the alias "inflatable pool" is † until attested).

name: Pool pump
definition: pump that circulates pool water through the filter.

name: Sand filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt in a bed of sand or glass media.

name: Cartridge filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt in a pleated cartridge.

name: DE filter
definition: pool filter that traps dirt on grids coated with diatomaceous earth.

name: Salt chlorinator (salt cell)
definition: device that makes chlorine from salt dissolved in the pool water by electrolysis.

name: Pool heater
definition: gas, electric or solar heater that warms pool water.

name: Pool heat pump
definition: heat pump that warms pool water with heat drawn from the air (K-176).

name: Robotic pool cleaner
definition: self-powered cleaner with its own motor that scrubs and vacuums the pool.

name: Suction-side pool cleaner
definition: cleaner driven by the suction of the pool pump.

name: Pressure-side pool cleaner
definition: cleaner driven by water pressure from the pool's return line or a booster pump.

name: Pool cover
definition: cover laid over a pool to keep out debris, hold heat or make it safe.

name: Pool test kit
definition: kit for testing pool water for chlorine, pH and other values (K-176).

name: Pool sanitiser
definition: chemical that disinfects pool water, chlorine tablets and granules included (K-176).

name: Mower blade
definition: replacement cutting blade made for a mower (S3).

name: Trimmer line
definition: replacement cutting line made for a string trimmer or brush cutter head (S3).

name: Pool-filter cartridge element
definition: replacement pleated element made for a pool cartridge filter (S3).
